rules.text: You can exchange items at any IKEA store by bringing your merchandise, photo ID, receipt (or online order confirmation) and the card you used for the purchase.

rules.text: You can start your return online.

rules.text: Small items purchased in store can be returned via FedEx at drop-off locations by contacting Customer Support Center.
rules.quote: Do you need to return a small item that you recently purchased at the store? Please contact the Customer Support Center to return via FedEx at any of over 50,000 FedEx drop-off locations.
